data.title: 毒蛇 · 客厅沙发的微醺依偎
data.description: 暖色调的静谧客厅内，毒蛇侧坐在宽大的真丝沙发上。贴身的粉白露脐短上衣衬托出纤细柔韧的腰肢，粉色波浪卷发散落在白皙胸口。她单手托腮，翡翠般的碧绿眼眸含着狡黠而甜美的笑意，微咬着下唇向镜头俏皮地眨了眨眼，散发着让人难以抵挡的恶魔系女友魅力。
data.location: dimly lit modern living room with soft ambient light
data.action: reclining playfully on plush sofa, cropped top showing midriff, pink wavy hair cascading over shoulders, biting lower lip with flirty wink, emerald eyes glittering
data.lighting: soft warm indoor downlights paired with pink neon mood strip along baseboards
data.mood: sweet dangerous seduction, mischievous girlfriend affection
data.promptProse: Lounging playfully on a velvet couch in warm room lighting, Viper wears a pink crop top and denim shorts. Her wavy pink hair cascades over bare shoulders as she winks with a charming, mischievous smile.
data.animaCaption: Viper lounging on a plush couch in a cute crop top, winking with an alluring smile.
